en.headline: Private car mounts pavement in Ho Man Tin; three pedestrians hurt
en.dek: A probationary-licence private car left Chung Hau Street near Carmel Secondary School on Friday afternoon, striking three pedestrians who were taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital.
body: Police said a private car travelling along Chung Hau Street in Ho Man Tin mounted the pavement near Carmel Secondary School at about 5.42pm on Friday, colliding with pedestrians.

Rescue personnel found one man and two women injured. All three were conscious and were taken by ambulance to Queen Elizabeth Hospital for treatment. One female casualty required head bandaging and another received oxygen; a male casualty walked into the accident and emergency department with bandaged knees.

The vehicle, which carried a probationary licence plate, sustained front-end damage and a cracked windscreen. A roadside sign was also knocked down. Police sealed the scene and are investigating the circumstances of the crash. A 26-year-old male driver was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving.

zh.headline: 何文田私家車剷上行人路 三途人受傷送院
zh.dek: 周五下午近6時，一輛掛P牌私家車在忠孝街近迦密中學失控上行人路，撞傷一男兩女，全部清醒送伊利沙伯醫院。
body: 警方表示，今日下午約5時42分，一輛私家車沿何文田忠孝街行駛，駛至迦密中學對開時懷疑失控剷上行人路，撞倒途人。
救援人員到場發現一男兩女傷者，全部清醒，由救護車送往伊利沙伯醫院治理。其中一名女傷者頭部需要包紮，另一人需用氧氣罩協助呼吸；男傷者雙膝包紮後自行步入急症室。
涉事私家車掛有P牌，車頭損毀，擋風玻璃碎裂，附近一支路牌亦被撞倒。警方封鎖現場調查，一名26歲男司機涉嫌危險駕駛被捕。
